title: Concept: ASP.NET web.config served with settings
description: An ASP.NET configuration file is served at this endpoint, so connection strings and application settings, which usually include credentials, are readable in clear text.
applicability: Responses served from an IIS or ASP.NET content root.
risk: A served configuration file hands over database credentials and API keys, and on IIS it is enough to reach the database directly; HIGH because the values are usable without cracking.
